sources.title: Taxi Tuner v4 - Full Manual — SayIntentions.AI Help Center
sources.snippet: TaxiTuner v4 is a specialized, web-based CAD interface designed to bridge the gap between Microsoft Flight Simulator (MSFS) airport data and the SayIntentions.AI air traffic control ecosystem. It allows users to define exactly how AI aircraft and the ATC engine perceive the physical layout of an airport.
